registry.hypothesis: Some model beats the 0.97/m house curve on held-out rounds for some stream and target.
registry.spec:
streams: aviator, skyward, skyward_deluxe, aviator_jul29, engine
targets: 1.5,2,3,5,10,20,50,100
models: empirical, logit(L2 C=0.05), hgb
validation: walk-forward, 5 folds, purge 200
metric: log-loss skill vs house, block bootstrap 250
family_correction: Benjamini-Hochberg q<0.05

registry.hypothesis: Shuffling Aviator destroys any skill (negative control).
registry.spec:
stream: aviator, permuted
target: 2x
models: logit, hgb

registry.hypothesis: Using the current round's duration leaks the outcome (leak detector must fire).
The Jul 3 burst creates a fake edge under shuffled cross-validation.
registry.spec:
stream: aviator + 7,662 burst rows
validation: shuffled 5-fold (wrong) vs walk-forward
model: hgb
target: 2x

registry.hypothesis: At least one of the 14 dashboard signals changes the next-round hit rate on aviator.
registry.spec:
stream: aviator
signals: 14
targets: 2x, 10x next round
test: two-proportion z vs non-signal rounds
family_correction: BH across 28

registry.hypothesis: Waiting longer changes the chance of the next hit on aviator ("overdue").
registry.spec:
stream: aviator
thresholds: 2,5,10,20,50,100
model: logit h(k) = b0 + b1 log k
null: b1 = 0
family_correction: BH across 6

registry.spec:
pairs: 10
metrics: rate2, rate10, rate100, low12, instant
test: two-proportion z
family_correction: BH across 50

registry.hypothesis: A stream's statistical fingerprint shifts during the capture period.
registry.spec:
block: 500
statistics: rate2, low12, rate10
detector: two-sided CUSUM k=0.5 h=5
